wiki.title: Josh Williams (politician)
wiki.extract: Josh Williams (born 1984) is an American politician who is a Republican member of the Ohio House of Representatives representing the 44th district. He was first elected on November 8, 2022, and assumed office January 1, 2023. He is the first Black Republican to be elected to the Ohio House in 50 years and the first Black majority whip in Ohio's history.
